name: DRC Rule Preset Builder
blurb: track, space and drill rules from a fab's capabilities, ready for the Rules tab
intro: Design rules from a board house's published minimums: the limits themselves for DRC, and working values with a margin for the net classes. Comes out as the Rules-tab JSON and a KiCad .kicad_dru file.
usage: Give the fab id (jlc2, jlc4, pcbway, osh2, osh4, generic or custom with ct/cc/cd/cv/ce in mm), copper weight (1oz/2oz), margin (limit, plus20, safe) and the signal and power track widths in mm. It returns the fab limits and working values for track, gap, via drill/pad, annular ring and edge clearance, a JSON object in the board room's Rules-tab shape (classes Default and Power, board minimums, a GND pour) and a KiCad .kicad_dru file. Use it when starting a board for a given fab.
sources: Fab capability pages (JLCPCB, PCBWay, OSH Park), minimums as published at the time of writing
Redline backend/rules.py SCHEMA (Rules tab format and bounds)
Heavy-copper 0.2 mm minimum and margins: rule of thumb
